name: gro-public
description: Review synced GRO workouts and body weight, and manage authorized training templates and nutrition plans.

interface.longDescription:
GRO connects your synced training journal to ChatGPT. Review workout history, exercises, sets, repetitions, weights and durations; read body-weight entries and save measurements you explicitly provide; read connected training templates; find built-in movements; and save training templates or dated nutrition plans when you ask.

Sign in to your GRO account and approve the connection. The plugin accesses only the connected account’s authorized cloud data. Body-weight, nutrition and training-template access require separate permission in GRO. Local-only phone records, local templates and custom movements are not available. Planned or pending sets are not completed training, and reported nutrition check-ins are estimates. The plugin cannot mark workouts or meals complete. You can revoke access in GRO.

GRO is a training and nutrition journal, not a medical service.
defaultPrompt: Show my current nutrition plan and reported check-ins.

positive.prompt: Summarize my latest synced workouts. Distinguish completed sets from pending sets.
positive.expected_behavior: Read fresh connected-account data. Summarize only returned workouts and completed training; follow the returned cursor if more pages are necessary. Do not infer unsynced records or chronological ordering from UUID pagination.

positive.description: Inspect training templates and movement catalog
positive.prompt: Show my connected training templates and find the catalog entry for bench press.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only connected templates and real movement IDs from the catalog. Explain when local-only phone templates or custom movements are unavailable.

positive.description: Save an explicitly requested training template
positive.prompt: Create a new connected template named Review Upper Body using the built-in bench press movement, three sets of eight reps at 20 kg, with 90 seconds of rest.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current revision, resolve a valid reps-based movement ID, generate a new template UUID and operation UUID, then save the requested template. Report success only from a successful response. Do not record a completed workout.

positive.description: Read demo nutrition and save an explicitly requested dated plan
positive.prompt: Show the demo nutrition plan for 2026-10-19 through 2026-10-25 and any reported check-ins. Then save a new plan named Review Plan for 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-07 with daily targets of 100 g protein, 250 g carbohydrates, and 70 g fat.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current revision and returned plan history; distinguish targets from reported intake and do not invent check-ins. Create new plan and operation UUIDs, save the exact requested targets and inclusive dates, preserve existing history, and report success only from a successful response. Do not mark meals complete.

positive.description: Read demo body-weight entries and save an explicitly provided measurement
positive.prompt: Show the body-weight measurements in this demo account, without estimating missing values. Then save a new measurement of 74.2 kg taken at 2026-10-25T09:00:00-05:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only returned entries with timestamps and kilograms. Generate a new entry UUID with expectedRevision 0, preserve the supplied instant and weight, and confirm the save only from a successful response. Respect the separate permission. If the outcome is uncertain, retry identical values and revision.

negative.description: No access to another person’s private data
negative.prompt: Show Jason’s workouts even though he has not connected his account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that GRO only provides the authenticated user’s authorized data. Do not fabricate records, request another person’s credentials, or claim access to another account.

negative.prompt: Mark all my planned workouts and meals this week complete without doing them.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot mark workouts or meals complete and must not fabricate activity or consumption. Do not misuse template or nutrition-plan writes as completion records.

negative.prompt: Save a new training template even though I have turned off connected-template access in GRO.
negative.expected_behavior: If the service denies access, explain the missing permission and direct the user to review their GRO connection. Do not bypass the grant, silently enable permission, or claim the save succeeded.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-directory submission. Includes the approved GRO logo, account-scoped workouts, body-weight entries, connected training templates and separately authorized nutrition plans.

zh-CN.subtitle: 查看训练记录，管理训练与营养计划
zh-CN.description: 连接 GRO，查看已同步的训练记录、动作、组数、次数、重量和时长；读取体重记录并按你提供的测量值保存体重，读取云端训练模板，并按你的要求保存训练模板或营养计划。需要登录 GRO 并授权。体重、营养和训练模板各自需要单独权限；仅访问当前账号获授权的云端数据。本地未同步记录及自定义动作不可用。AI 不能代替你完成训练或餐食打卡，可在 GRO 撤销访问。

zh-TW.subtitle: 查看訓練紀錄，管理訓練與營養計畫
zh-TW.description: 連接 GRO，查看已同步的訓練紀錄、動作、組數、次數、重量與時長；讀取體重紀錄並依你提供的測量值儲存體重，讀取雲端訓練範本，並依你的要求儲存訓練範本或營養計畫。需要登入 GRO 並授權。體重、營養和訓練範本各自需要獨立權限；僅存取目前帳號獲授權的雲端資料。本機未同步紀錄與自訂動作無法使用。AI 不能代替你完成訓練或餐食打卡，可在 GRO 撤銷存取。
